result.summary:
Implemented the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR-approved design (lib/letflow/design/iss0457-splice-first-wins.md) in full. Picked implementation shape (i) conditional-preservation from section 2: in handle_string_token/5's depth-1 "status" match branch, a new local `winner` is computed as `new_best` only when `best` was `nil`, otherwise `best` is threaded through unchanged -- the recursive scan_for_status/4 call always receives `winner`. `acc` still accumulates `prefix_before_value <> old_value_raw` for every depth-1 "status" match regardless of whether it becomes the winner, exactly as the design's (i) shape specifies, so the forward scan is unaffected and only the FIRST depth-1 "status" match is ever kept as `best`.

Both corrected-text edits landed verbatim: (3.1) lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex's code comment (originally :487-491, now :487-495 after the added lines) replaced the false last-key-wins claim with the FIRST-key-wins text plus the jason 1.4.5 probe citation and the ISS-0457 correction note, copied verbatim from the design's section 3.1. (3.2) lib/letflow/design/iss0442-lint-handoffs-minimal-diff-autofix.md's section 2.2 step 2 (originally ~:197-204) replaced with the design's section 3.2 corrected text verbatim.

Also applied the MINOR, non-blocking prose fix CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR flagged: iss0457-splice-first-wins.md's section 0 second bullet now says `Map.get(data, "status")` with `data` from non-bang `Jason.decode(raw)` inside a `with` clause, matching the real code at :414-446, instead of the inaccurate `Jason.decode!(raw)` paraphrase.

Only files touched: lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex, lib/letflow/design/iss0442-lint-handoffs-minimal-diff-autofix.md, lib/letflow/design/iss0457-splice-first-wins.md (the permitted MINOR fix), and this handoff file -- no file outside the permitted scope modified.
